remarks: MODERN DESIGN MEETS EVERYDAY COMFORT! Welcome to this beautifully designed 1,600 sq. ft. two-storey home offering 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and a thoughtfully planned layout perfect for modern living. Step inside to a welcoming foyer and a versatile main-floor den, ideal for a home office or study. The heart of the home features a bright, open-concept kitchen with a central island and pantry, flowing seamlessly into the dining area and spacious family room—perfect for entertaining or relaxing with loved ones. Upstairs, retreat to the generous primary bedroom complete with a private ensuite. Two additional bedrooms, a full bathroom, and a spacious bonus room provide plenty of room for the whole family. With its stylish exterior, functional floor plan, and inviting living spaces, this home offers the perfect balance of comfort, elegance, and practicality. A BEAUTIFUL PLACE TO CALL HOME! (id:67522)
